title: Present Simple: he / she
grammarTitle: Present Simple: He / She / It — рассказываем о других
grammarNote:
В Модуле 4 мы научились говорить о СВОИХ привычках:
"I study every day." · "I play guitar in the evenings." · "We go to the library after lunch."

Теперь мы учимся рассказывать о ДРУГИХ людях — о том, что делают наши друзья, одногруппники, кумиры. Посмотри, как это звучит в нашем модуле:

"Samal takes photos every day." → не «take» — «takes»!
"Bekzat trains after every class." → не «train» — «trains»!
"Ainur reads in five languages." → не «read» — «reads»!
"Zarina cooks beshbarmak on Sundays." → не «cook» — «cooks»!
"Aibek plays guitar every evening." → не «play» — «plays»!

⚠️ ГЛАВНОЕ ПРАВИЛО:
Когда подлежащее — He / She / It (или любое имя: Samal, Bekzat, Zarina) → глагол получает окончание -s / -es / -ies.

Это правило простое, но критически важное. Без -s твой английский звучит незаконченно. С -s — ты звучишь как уверенный носитель!

💡 Как запомнить? Думай так:
"He/She/It" → всегда добавляю что-то к глаголу.
"I/You/We/They" → глагол остаётся чистым, без изменений.

grammarTable.subject: I / You / We / They
grammarTable.example: I play chess. · You cook well. · We read books. · They train every day.

grammarTable.subject: He / She / It + имя
grammarTable.example: He plays chess. · She cooks well. · Ainur reads. · Bekzat trains.

grammarExtra.title: Правила написания окончания для He / She / It

rows.example: play → plays · read → reads · take → takes · train → trains · run → runs
watch → watches · go → goes · do → does · finish → finishes · teach → teaches
study → studies · carry → carries · try → tries · fly → flies · copy → copies
play → plays · enjoy → enjoys · say → says · stay → stays · buy → buys
I have a camera. → She has a camera. (НЕ «haves»!)
I am a student. → She is a student. / He is passionate about chess.

rows.form: He / She / It → doesn't + base form
rows.example: Zarina doesn't use a recipe. · Bekzat doesn't skip training.
✅ She doesn't cook. ❌ She doesn't cooks. (нет двух окончаний!)
"Timur does not play basketball every day." = "Timur doesn't play..."
I don't play. · He doesn't play. · They don't play. · She doesn't play.
❌ She don't cook → ✅ She doesn't cook. (He/She/It → DOESN'T!)
"Does Samal take photos every day?" — "Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't."
✅ Does she play? ❌ Does she plays? (нет двух окончаний в вопросе)
"Does Bekzat train daily?" — "Yes, he does." / "No, he doesn't."
"What does Aibek do in his free time?" → "He plays guitar."
"How often does Ainur visit the library?" → "Three times a week."
"Where does Timur play basketball?" → "On the WKU court."

grammarExtra.title: Useful verbs for describing hobbies — He / She + ...

rows.example: She loves cooking. · He enjoys playing chess. · She likes hiking.
He spends time coding every morning. · She spends hours photographing.

rows.form: is passionate about / is obsessed with
rows.example: He is passionate about football. · She is obsessed with photography.

rows.form: is interested in / is good at
rows.example: She is interested in languages. · He is good at strategy games.
She prefers cooking to eating out. · He hates missing training.
She goes hiking on Sundays. · He goes swimming twice a week.

grammarTip:
Шпаргалка Present Simple He/She — три правила:

① Утверждение: He/She/It + verb-s
   "Samal takes photos." · "Bekzat trains every day." · "Ainur reads five languages."

② Отрицание: He/She/It + doesn't + verb (без -s!)
   "He doesn't cook." · "She doesn't skip class." · "It doesn't matter."

③ Вопрос: Does + He/She/It + verb (без -s!)
   "Does she photograph landscapes?" · "Does he train on weekends?"

💡 Секретный лайфхак:
В предложении с He/She — окончание -s стоит только ОДИН раз:
→ Либо на глаголе (утверждение): She cook-S
→ Либо на does/doesn't: DOES-n't she cook / DOES she cook
Никогда: "Does she cooks?" или "She doesn't cooks!" ❌

exercises.text: Samal ___ photos of the WKU campus every day.
exercises.hint: Samal = She → She takes. He/She/It + verb+s.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct form of the verb.
exercises.text: Ainur ___ (read) books in five different languages.
"Zarina cook beshbarmak every Sunday" is correct English.
exercises.hint: Zarina = She → "Zarina cookS beshbarmak every Sunday." Don't forget the -s!

exercises.text: Bekzat ___ training — he goes every single day.
exercises.hint: Bekzat = He → doesn't + base form. Never "doesn't skips"!

exercises.text: ___ Timur play basketball three times a week? — Yes, he does.
exercises.hint: He → Does. "Does Timur play...?" (base form after Does)

exercises.text: "___ Aibek do in his free time?" — "He plays guitar every evening."
exercises.hint: Aibek = He → "What does he do?" (does + base form)
"goes hiking" ✅ — go → goes (He/She/It). Others miss the -s or use don't instead of doesn't.

exercises.text: "Does she goes hiking every Sunday?" is correct English.
exercises.hint: After Does → base form! "Does she GO hiking?" — never "goes" in a Does-question.
